title: quassia pentandra
intro: Quassia pentandra, commonly known as Quassia or Yellow Quassia, is a tropical plant species native to the Caribbean and Central America. The health benefits of Quassia pentandra include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues, such as diarrhea and stomach pain, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Quassia pentandra include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Quassia pentandra include quassin and limonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
